description:
Koh Chang’s Ghost Ship: What Remains?

The Galaxy at Koh Chang Grand Lagoona became one of Thailand’s most memorable abandoned-site stories—but the familiar image of the intact ghost ship is now history. The ship-hotel was severely damaged by fire on 3 December 2024, and its upper structure was dismantled in 2025. This travel-history Short follows the location, resort story, fire, and what sources say remains. The map pin shown is approximate, not survey-grade; confirm the location and current access before visiting. Do not trespass or enter damaged structures.
